ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 29 Oct 2026
points: Your site shows 12051 reviews, yet 0 of 27 live ads carry that number. A new buyer sees no proof before the click, so the sale stalls. Put 12051 on every creative, and open two ads with a review quote.

11 of your 20 fixed-copy ads open on the same “bye bye press ons” story, so most of the account repeats one pitch. Test two or three new angles from your product, like Patterns or Ultra Short Square, against it.

Your site answers how it ships, yet 0 of 27 live ads mention shipping. A new buyer must click to learn when the set arrives, and many will not. Put the shipping answer in line one of ads for new buyers.
One exact copy runs in 11 of your 20 ads, so the same message reaches the same buyers. Keep the body copy, change the opening line and creative in each, and shoot a different product photo per ad.
